headline: JPMorganChase Doubles Down on Housing, Aiming to Deploy $750 Billion Through 2035—Up by More Than $200 Billion—Through Its American Dream Initiative
summary: NEW YORK, August 03, 2026--JPMorganChase today announced the firm intends to deploy over $750 billion through 2035 to increase housing supply and support homeownership in the United States. This marks a nearly 40 percent increase in the firm’s housing capital deployment compared to the past decade, and includes financing for 1,000,000 affordable housing units and helping 500,000 homebuyers purchase homes.
